svg.title: Every headline result in the series: final value against DCA
svg.desc: Strip chart of the ratio of final value to DCA across all the main experiments: VAS next-day, VAS delays, VAS brokerage, the Topaz portfolio, and 20 other funds.
svg.text: Every headline result in the series: final value against DCA
Each dot is one rule tested on one fund or setting. The black tick is the median. Right of the grey line means the dip rule finished ahead of DCA.
